areas.name: English
areas.overview: The English learning area develops learners' communicative competence in listening, speaking, reading, and writing. It emphasizes the use of English as a global language for effective communication, critical thinking, and lifelong learning.
objectives: Develop communicative competence in English across all macro skills.
Foster critical thinking and literacy through a variety of texts.
Enhance oral and written expression in academic and real-life contexts.
Integrate Philippine and international literature to broaden perspective.
bestPractices: Literacy monitoring via ELLNA and CRLA
announcements: Regional English Festival of Talents entries now open

areas.name: Mathematics
areas.overview: Mathematics promotes problem solving, critical thinking, and logical reasoning. The curriculum equips learners with essential numeracy skills and the ability to apply mathematical concepts to real-life situations.
objectives: Develop learners' understanding of mathematical concepts and operations.
Cultivate problem solving and critical thinking abilities.
Apply mathematics to daily life and higher education.
Foster appreciation of the beauty and utility of mathematics.
announcements: Math Month theme announced for the year

areas.name: Science
areas.overview: Science education develops scientific literacy and inquiry skills. Learners explore the natural world through hands-on investigations, problem solving, and the responsible application of scientific knowledge.
objectives: Develop scientific inquiry, observation, and experimentation skills.
Promote scientific literacy and responsible decision making.
Foster innovation and appreciation for STEM careers.
Integrate environmental stewardship in science education.
announcements: Regional Science & Technology Fair winners announced

areas.name: Filipino
areas.overview: Ang Filipino ay naglalayong malinang ang kakayahang komunikatibo at kritikal ng mga mag-aaral sa pamamagitan ng pag-aaral ng wika, panitikan, at kulturang Filipino.
objectives: Malinang ang kakayahang komunikatibo sa Filipino.
Maunawaan at pahalagahan ang panitikang Filipino.
Maiugnay ang wika sa pagkakakilanlang kultural.
Maging epektibong tagapag-ugnay ng mga kaisipan at damdamin.
bestPractices: Paggamit ng Mother Tongue at Filipino

eps.name: Leonardo B. Mission
responsibilities: Lead Buwan ng Wika and language programs

areas.name: Araling Panlipunan
areas.overview: Araling Panlipunan develops understanding of the Filipino people, society, culture, and environment. It nurtures citizenship, historical consciousness, and responsible participation in national and global life.
objectives: Develop historical and civic literacy among learners.
Foster a sense of national identity and responsibility.
Understand the interplay of geography, culture, and society.
Promote active, informed citizenship.
announcements: Araling Panlipunan Month celebrated across the region

eps.name: Jade T. Palomar
eps.position: Education Program Supervisor - Araling Panlipunan & Kindergarten
responsibilities: Supervise Araling Panlipunan and Kindergarten programs

areas.name: Values Education
areas.overview: Values Education nurtures the moral and spiritual development of learners. It cultivates positive character, ethical decision making, and responsible citizenship anchored on the Filipino core values.
objectives: Develop sound moral and ethical character.
Nurture the Filipino core values in everyday life.
Promote responsible decision making and empathy.
Support multigrade classrooms with responsive values programs.

eps.name: Maria Isabel R. Cunanan
eps.position: Education Program Supervisor - Values Education & Multigrade

areas.name: MAPEH
areas.overview: MAPEH develops learners holistically through Music, Arts, Physical Education, and Health. It nurtures creativity, physical well-being, and healthy lifestyle habits, including special curricular programs such as SPA, SPS, and SPFL.
objectives: Develop artistic and creative expression.
Promote physical fitness and lifelong health.
Support special programs in the Arts, Sports, and Foreign Languages.
Foster appreciation of Filipino and global culture.

eps.name: Ildefonso E. Libdan Jr.
eps.position: Education Program Supervisor - MAPEH · SPA · SPS · SPFL
responsibilities: Supervise MAPEH curriculum and special programs
Manage SPA, SPS, and SPFL programs

areas.name: Technology & Livelihood Education
areas.overview: TLE equips learners with practical skills in the fields of Home Economics, Industrial Arts, Agri-Fishery Arts, and ICT. It prepares learners for employment, entrepreneurship, and higher education.
objectives: Develop technical and vocational competencies.
Foster entrepreneurship and livelihood skills.
Support the Strengthened Senior High School curriculum.
Integrate workplace readiness and values.

eps.name: Crisanto M. Bulado
eps.position: Education Program Supervisor - TLE & Strengthened Senior High School
responsibilities: Oversee TLE and Senior High School programs

areas.name: Special Curricular Programs
areas.overview: Special Curricular Programs provide focused learning opportunities for learners with advanced potential in the arts, sports, and foreign languages, as well as special academic tracks that enrich the basic education experience.
objectives: Develop advanced talents in arts, sports, and languages.
Provide enriched and responsive learning tracks.
Support Science and Technology and other specialized programs.
Nurture holistic and excellent learners.

areas.name: Inclusive Education
areas.overview: Inclusive Education ensures that every learner—regardless of ability, culture, or background—receives quality education. It covers Special Needs Education (SNED), Indigenous Peoples Education (IPED), and Madrasah Education.
objectives: Ensure equitable access to quality education for all learners.
Support learners with special needs through responsive programs.
Respect and integrate indigenous knowledge systems.
Provide culturally appropriate education for Muslim learners.
bestPractices: Partnership with IP and Muslim communities
announcements: Regional Indigenous Peoples Day celebration held

eps.name: Inclusive Education Team
responsibilities: Coordinate SNED, IPED, and Madrasah programs

areas.name: Strengthened Senior High School
areas.overview: The Strengthened Senior High School program provides learners with relevant, responsive, and learner-centered pathways across academic, technical-vocational, arts and design, and sports tracks to prepare them for their chosen careers.
objectives: Provide quality senior high school education across all tracks.
Prepare learners for higher education, employment, and entrepreneurship.
Strengthen partnerships with industry and higher education institutions.
Support learners' career guidance and development.

eps.name: Crisanto M. Bulado
eps.position: Education Program Supervisor - Strengthened Senior High School

areas.name: Learning Resources Mgmt & Dev System
areas.overview: The Learning Resources Management and Development System (LRMDS) ensures the availability, quality, and accessibility of learning resources. It manages the development, production, and distribution of materials for all learning areas.
objectives: Manage the development and quality assurance of learning resources.
Ensure accessibility of materials to all schools and learners.
Coordinate the production and distribution of resources.
Support curriculum implementation through responsive materials.

eps.name: Arturo B. Tingson
responsibilities: Manage the LRMDS at the regional level
